questions.prompt: Who acts last on the flop?

choices.text: The button, if still in the hand.
The first player who posted a blind.

questions.explanation: Postflop action starts left of the button and ends on the button.

questions.prompt: You want a seat change. Do it…

choices.text: Between hands, through the dealer, without delaying the game.
By swapping chips with a stranger.

questions.explanation: Seat changes happen between hands and follow the room's list or dealer.

choices.text: Throwing them toward the muck when you call.
Leaving them behind your chips, unattended.
Keeping them on the felt in front of you, usually capped by a chip.
Holding them up for the table to see.

questions.explanation: A chip on your cards helps stop them from being taken as a fold.

questions.prompt: The dealer pushes you the pot and an argument starts. You should…

choices.text: Scoop and leave before anyone speaks.
Leave the pot, let the dealer control it, and call the floor if needed.

questions.explanation: Do not take a disputed pot. The dealer and floor resolve procedure.
